summary.text: One of Penelope's suitors in Apollodorus' catalogue of the fifty-seven wooers from Dulichium — attested only among the wooers who came against Odysseus' house, and not to be confused with the later historian of that name.

story.text: Apollodorus names Hellanicus among the suitors who devoured Odysseus' substance, listed after Pseras and before Periphron in the long company of Penelope's wooers.
